videos.title: Cem Karsan Expects Another $10 Trillion Printed Within Nine Months
videos.description:
Cem Karsan of Kai Wealth expects another 10 trillion dollars to be printed over the next six to nine months, which he compares in scale to the COVID response or larger. His point is about the sheer magnitude of what’s coming, and why it matters for how you think about currency debasement and positioning.
